title: Foldnano community plugin listing, version 1
description: registry.json: the community plugins Foldnano lists in its Hub. Each entry repeats display fields from the plugin's fplugin.json (scripts/check.mjs keeps them equal) and pins the exact zip by SHA-256.

url.description: HTTPS link, e.g. a profile or lab page.

id.description: Unique plugin identifier: a letter, then letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (at most 64), e.g. "my-plugin". Checked at install.

version.description: The plugin's own version, as a semantic version (e.g. "1.2.0"). Bump it whenever plugin files change: Foldnano caches files by this value. Checked at install.

tags.description: Labels that describe the plugin, e.g. ["auto-staple", "export"]: letters and digits, words joined by hyphens, at most 32 characters each. Repeats are refused ignoring case.

maintainers.description: Who made it a Foldnano plugin and keeps it updated. Omit when the authors maintain it.

license.description: SPDX license id or expression of the plugin as shipped, e.g. "MIT" or "MIT AND BSD-3-Clause".

repository.description: HTTPS URL of the plugin's public source repository. Required: the review needs the source, and for copyleft plugins it is how the source stays available.

upstream.description: HTTPS URL of the original project, when the plugin is a fork.

iconSvg.description: Text of the SVG file the manifest's "icon" names, so the Hub can show it before install.

url.description: Where the zip is downloaded from: the author's host, or a hosted copy in this repo.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact zip, lowercase hex. Foldnano refuses a download that doesn't match.

fetch.description: direct: Foldnano downloads url itself (the host must send Access-Control-Allow-Origin). manual: the user downloads url and drops the zip into Foldnano.
